{"explanation": "This document was held because it is a credit note, which AP handles manually rather than posting as a Bill, and because the line "Pallet strapping kit" is billed at 3397.84 ZAR against a PO unit price of 3058.06 ZAR, which is outside the 61.16 ZAR tolerance. Check whether the document is correctly typed as a credit note, confirm the agreed price on PO-ITNDCZAREF, and ask the vendor to correct the line or confirm the price before any posting decision.","email_subject": "Query on Invoice NdC90426 and PO-ITNDCZAREF","email_body": "Dear Kransberg Tyre & Parts team,

Thank you for your document NdC90426 dated 2026-03-17, totalling 3907.52 ZAR, referencing PO-ITNDCZAREF.

We have two points to clarify before we can process it:

1. Document type: our system shows this document as a credit note. Could you confirm whether it is a credit note or an invoice?
2. Pallet strapping kit: this line is billed at 3397.84 ZAR, while the purchase order unit price is 3058.06 ZAR for a quantity of 1. Could you confirm the agreed price or send a corrected invoice?

Please reply with a corrected document or written confirmation so we can review it. We appreciate your help.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable"}
